subject: About the folding chairs
text:
Following up on your earlier note about the folding chairs. I did not mean to sound uncertain, and I appreciate you checking. I called the hall yesterday and confirmed that only three of their old chairs match the color of the current ones. They said the remaining pieces were replaced during the roof repair.

That makes the set uneven, and I am worried people will notice. For the community morning, visual order matters more than usual, because there will be photos and a small ceremony. I would rather have a simple room than a mismatched one.

One possible alternative is the plastic stackable chairs the library uses for its reading events. They are neutral, light, and easier to store. The branch manager may lend us enough for twenty guests if we return them clean on the same afternoon.

I can pick them up after the school pickup line, if that works. Alternatively, we could borrow the folding stools from the senior center, though those are lower than expected. The library set seems more presentable.

If you still think the chairs should be bought, I will pay for my share. I do not want this to become a burden. I only wanted to pause and consider other options before the deposit deadline. Let me know by tomorrow evening, so I can tell the volunteer coordinator what to expect. I appreciate sorting this out before Sunday.
